No parity restriction is imposed; \(n/2\) is real even when n is odd. The selected parameters imply \(s\ge2\), \(0<r<1\), \(\ell>0\) and \(1-r^2>0\). These domain facts and every needed L1/measure identity are proved inside existing canonical dependencies, never supplied as extra assumptions. All expectations are actual real Bochner integrals. Absolute integrability is a conclusion. Standard totalized division/rpow off the measure support changes none of the asserted integrals. \(\sigma\) is the actual normalized ambient surface law defined below. The A1 input is used only in the unambiguous source range \(n\ge3\). \(\begin{aligned}s&=\sqrt\kappa,&r&=\left(1-\frac1n\right)\frac{s-1}{s+1},\\\ell&=\frac{4ns+(s-1)^2}{8n(n-1)},&v&=\frac{(-1)^n}{n}\left(\frac{s-1}{s+1}\right)^n\frac{(1-1/n)^{n/2}}{1-r^2}.\end{aligned}\) \(\tau=\mathrm{vol}.\mathrm{toSphere},\quad\sigma=\tau(S^{n-1})^{-1}\iota_*\tau,\quad U(y)=y_1,\quad D(y)=1+r^2-2rU(y),\quad f(y)=\frac{(s+1)U(y)-(s-1)}{D(y)^{n/2}}.\)

∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ),
    let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
    let r : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1))
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let τ : Measure (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) :=
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).toSphere
    let σ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      (τ Set.univ)⁻¹ • τ.map (fun y => y.val)
    let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun y =>
      ((s + 1) * WithLp.ofLp y j0 - (s - 1)) /
        (1 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * WithLp.ofLp y j0) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
    Integrable f σ ∧ (∫ y, f y ∂σ) = -(s - 1) / ((n : ℝ) * (1 - r ^ 2))
decoder_context: EuclideanSpace real (Fin n) is real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its standard l2 norm. Fin n indexes coordinates from zero through n-1. WithLp.ofLp y j is coordinate j of y.

Real powers use Real.rpow, defined for all real bases. Real division and inverse are totalized at zero. All n/2 dimension exponents use real division; natural powers have natural exponents. Integrable means genuine real Bochner absolute integrability under the displayed measure. No L1 fact or moment value is a supplied premise.

For a measurable subset B of the unit-sphere subtype, volume.toSphere(B) is n times Euclidean Lebesgue volume of the cone {a*z:0<a<1,z in B}. Measure.map by the subtype inclusion is the ambient pushforward. Measure scalar multiplication and inverse mass use extended nonnegative real scalars.

/-! The literal selected numerator immediately before Eq24. Both actual
normalized surface moments are consumed; no moment value is assumed.
This is the unchanged canonical declaration promoted from its focused test. -/

theorem selected_numerator_value {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) :
    let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
    let r : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1))
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let τ : Measure (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) :=
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).toSphere
    let σ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      (τ Set.univ)⁻¹ • τ.map (fun y => y.val)
    let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun y =>
      ((s + 1) * WithLp.ofLp y j0 - (s - 1)) /
        (1 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * WithLp.ofLp y j0) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
    Integrable f σ ∧ (∫ y, f y ∂σ) = -(s - 1) / ((n : ℝ) * (1 - r ^ 2)) := by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
  let r : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1))
  let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
  let τ : Measure (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) :=
    (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).toSphere
  let σ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
    (τ Set.univ)⁻¹ • τ.map (fun y => y.val)
  let K : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun y =>
    (1 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * WithLp.ofLp y j0) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
  let g0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun y => 1 / K y
  let g1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun y => WithLp.ofLp y j0 / K y
  let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun y =>
    ((s + 1) * WithLp.ofLp y j0 - (s - 1)) / K y
  change Integrable f σ ∧ (∫ y, f y ∂σ) = -(s - 1) / ((n : ℝ) * (1 - r ^ 2))
  have ht := SelectedTilt.selected_tilt hn hκ
  have hm := SphericalPoisson.spherical_poisson_moments (by omega : 2 ≤ n)
    r ht.1 ht.2.1
  change Integrable g0 σ ∧ Integrable g1 σ ∧
    (∫ y, g0 y ∂σ) = 1 / (1 - r ^ 2) ∧
    (∫ y, g1 y ∂σ) = r / (1 - r ^ 2) at hm
  have heq : f = (fun y => (s + 1) * g1 y - (s - 1) * g0 y) := by
    funext y
    dsimp [f, g0, g1]
    ring
  have hf : Integrable f σ := by
    rw [heq]
    exact (hm.2.1.const_mul (s + 1)).sub (hm.1.const_mul (s - 1))
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : n ≠ 0)
  have hs : s + 1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by dsimp [s]; positivity)
  have hnum : (s + 1) * r - (s - 1) = -(s - 1) / (n : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [r]
    field_simp
    ring
  refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
  rw [heq, integral_sub (hm.2.1.const_mul _) (hm.1.const_mul _),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, hm.2.2.1, hm.2.2.2]
  calc
    _ = ((s + 1) * r - (s - 1)) / (1 - r ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hnum, div_div]

end

reconstruction.text:
For every natural number n with 3 ≤ n and every real number κ with 4 ≤ κ, let E be real n-dimensional Euclidean space, with coordinates indexed by Fin n = {0, …, n−1}, and let S = {y ∈ E : ‖y‖ = 1} be the unit-sphere subtype. Set s = √κ and r = (1 − 1/n)((s − 1)/(s + 1)), with n interpreted as a real number in these expressions, and let j₀ be coordinate 0 in Fin n.

Let τ be the measure (volume on E).toSphere on S. Thus, for every measurable subset B of S, τ(B) is n times the Euclidean Lebesgue volume of the cone {a z : 0 < a < 1, z ∈ B}. Let ι : S → E be the subtype inclusion and define the ambient measure σ on E by σ = (τ(S))⁻¹ • (ι_*τ). Here the inverse mass and scalar multiplication of the measure use extended nonnegative real scalars.

Define the real-valued function f on E by
f(y) = ((s + 1)y₀ − (s − 1)) / (1 + r² − 2r y₀)^(n/2),
where y₀ is coordinate j₀ of y and n/2 is real division. Then f is absolutely Bochner integrable with respect to σ, and its real Bochner integral over E satisfies
∫_E f(y) dσ(y) = −(s − 1)/(n(1 − r²)).

The exponent n/2 denotes the real power Real.rpow, defined for all real bases; the squares have natural exponent 2. All displayed real divisions and inverses have their totalized Lean meaning. Integrability is part of the conclusion, not a premise.
